program.name: Trap Ladders
program.subject: Neck & traps
program.blurb: A traps-and-neck ladder every day, shrugs and neck lifts a rep at a time, then holds.
program.about: Every day climbs a ladder: a shrug and a neck lift, then two of each, then three, as far as the time allows. The trap move is a shrug, an upright row or a high pull; the neck move a prone neck lift or a chin tuck. A short block of gentle neck holds and upper-back work follows. One day leads with the traps, the other with the neck. The neck reps stay slow and small. Abs finish every session; Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
